name: How do I know if my home can support a second-story addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my home can support a second-story addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining if your home can support a second-story addition involves assessing the existing foundation and structural integrity. A structural engineer will evaluate the current footings, walls, and load-bearing elements to ensure they can handle the additional weight. This initial assessment is a critical step in the planning phase. You'll need to share any available architectural plans or past renovation documents to assist in this evaluation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A structural engineer must assess your existing foundation and structural integrity to determine if it can support a second-story addition.
